Subject: Re: Lighthouse Diagnostics — demo this week

Hey Jonas,

Quick heads up — our field team schedule shifted unexpectedly. We just confirmed that the primary stakeholders (Tom and I) will be on-site with a client from Dec 3–7 and then taking a short team break. That conflicts with the slot you proposed for Dec 5.

Can we shift the live demo out to the week of Dec 13? If that's tight on your side, we'd be open to a hybrid approach: a shorter live walkthrough on Dec 8 (when a subset of our team is available) plus a recorded demo your team can send for the folks in the field.

We also attached our site-visit itinerary so you can see the exact windows.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

— Asha

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse Diagnostics — demo this week

Asha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the itinerary. Totally understandable.

Two options that would work on our end:
1) Move the full live demo to the week of Dec 13 — I'm available Dec 14 or 15 in the afternoon (PST).
2) Hybrid: short 30–35 minute live walkthrough on Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PST focused on integration and security, then we provide a polished 20–25 minute recording covering full product flow and Q&A notes for the folks on-site. We can also include a short annotated SSO/KMS slide for your security team.

If you want the recorded asset to be tailored to your use case, we can: record with your logo and include a short intro addressing Tom's points about on-device inference. That would take two business days to produce after the live session.

Pulling Vanessa in — Vanessa, can you confirm recording turnaround and whether we should surface SOC2 snippets in the recording?

Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Asha Rao <asha@lighthouse-dx.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse Diagnostics — demo this week

Thanks for the context. Recording turnaround is 48 business hours for a customized edit (trim, intro slide, captions). We can include a 1-slide SOC 2 excerpt and a link to our audit summary in the post-demo package.

If you go hybrid, we'll capture the live 30-min walkthrough and produce the annotated recording by Dec 10, so your team on-site can watch it during travel. If you prefer the full live on Dec 14/15, we can leave it as a single session but recommend scheduling a shorter follow-up with engineering for deeper integration questions.

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
